text: This bunker has room for one hundred thousand people.
asr: This bunker has room for 100,000 people.

text: One hundred thousand beds, and every single one is empty.
asr: 100,000 beds, and every single one is empty.

text: The blast door won't seal until it's full.
Everyone who comments gets a bed, with their name on the door.
At one thousand, the lights come on.
At ten thousand, the air starts flowing.
And at one hundred thousand, the door seals, and we wait out the end of the world.
asr: And at 100,000 the door seals and we wait out the end of the world.

text: But there's something I haven't told you.
Bed four oh four was already locked from the inside when we dug it out.
asr: Bed 404 was already locked from the inside when we dug it out.

text: Pick your spot in the comments. By the pantry, next to the generators, or right beside four oh four.
asr: Pick your spot in the comments by the pantry next to the generators or right beside 404.

text: Follow me, and get inside before the door closes.
